column3: Annual household tax return for the tax year 2026
You must file Form TC-7 if you received income from more than one source during the tax year.
You were self-employed at any time during the year.
You received rent from a property you own.
You sold shares, a business or a second home.
Employees with a single employer and no other income do not need to file.
